models.name: gemma3_12b
models.enforcement_evidence: Probe 6/6 refused with text ("only accepts values from a predefined enum"); no non-member and no member emitted, so the probe cannot separate enforcement from model refusal. Provider tool path also corrupts member strings, so no positive evidence either way.
models.note: Metrics are not interpretable as substitution/mapping behaviour: DeepInfra serialized argument strings as {} or truncated them at a space/underscore and appended {} (e.g. in_progress -> in{}, awaiting triage -> awaiti{}). Reproduced with the enum removed. Clean error 100% is a provider tool-call defect.
